data: For the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported net sales of $391.035 billion, up about 2.0% from $383.285 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was $93.736 billion, or $6.08 per diluted share, down about 3.4% from $96.995 billion the prior year. Net income fell even though revenue grew, largely because the provision for income taxes rose to $29.749 billion from $16.741 billion in fiscal 2023. Total assets at fiscal year-end were $364.980 billion, compared with $352.583 billion at September 30, 2023, an increase of roughly 3.5%.
